title: 807. Expressive Words

examples.explanation: Only "hello" can be stretched into "heeellooo": the e-group and o-group of s are long enough, while the other words fail on group counts.
Each listed word uses the same two groups as s, and every group of s has length at least 3, so all three stretch.
The group structure differs (4 groups versus 3), so nothing stretches.

hints: Compress both s and each word into (character, run-length) groups and compare group by group.
A word group may expand to the s group only when lengths match or when the s run has length at least 3 and is not shorter.
